mechanism: Verapamil inhibits CYP3A4 and P-glycoprotein, potentially increasing amoxicillin clavulanate levels; amoxicillin may reduce verapamil efficacy through altered GI absorption and enterohepatic circulation.
action: Monitor for increased beta-lactam adverse effects (GI symptoms, rash) and verapamil efficacy; no dose adjustment typically required but clinical monitoring is advisable.
